ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, point $N(0, 6)$ lies on the plane, and point $M$ is on the negative $x$-axis with $ON = 3OM$. $A$ is a point on line segment $MN$, $AB \perp x$-axis with $B$ as the foot of the perpendicular, and $AC \perp y$-axis with $C$ as the foot of the perpendicular. Write down the coordinates of point $M$.
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given, $\because N(0,6)$,\\
$\therefore ON=6$,\\
$\because ON=3OM$,\\
$\therefore OM=2$,\\
$\therefore$ the coordinates of point M are $\boxed{(-2,0)}$;
